test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements about pteridophytes are correct?

Statements:

A. They include horsetails and ferns.

B. Pteridophytes are used for medicinal purposes and as soil-binders.

C. They are very advanced type of plants on earth, which evolved very recently.

D. Evolutionarily, they are the first terrestrial plants to possess vascular tissues – xylem and phloem.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only A, B and D**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Pteridophytes** include horsetails and ferns, which are vascular plants widely distributed in terrestrial ecosystems. (Source: NCERT Biology Textbook, Class 11)
 
• Pteridophytes serve ecological and economic purposes, such as being used for medicinal applications and acting as soil-binders to prevent erosion. (Source: Current Environmental Science Research)
 
• Evolutionarily, pteridophytes are the **first terrestrial plants to possess vascular tissues** like xylem and phloem for water and nutrient transportation. (Source: NCERT Biology Textbook, Class 11)
 
• Pteridophytes are ancient plants that bridge the gap between bryophytes and gymnosperms; they are not recently evolved or highly advanced plants. (Source: Evolutionary Botany Studies)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vascular Tissues in Plants:**

 
 
• Xylem primarily carries water and dissolved minerals, while phloem transports organic nutrients like sugars.
 
• The presence of vascular tissues marks the evolutionary advancement of pteridophytes compared to bryophytes.
 
 
 
• **Horsetails and Ferns:**
 
 
• Horsetails belong to the genus *Equisetum* and are characterized by jointed stems and spore-based reproduction.
 
• Ferns are non-flowering vascular plants with large, divided leaves known as fronds.
 
• Both horsetails and ferns are widely used in horticulture and ecological restoration projects.
 
 
 
• **Ecological Role of Pteridophytes:**
 
 
• Pteridophytes contribute to soil stabilization, especially in areas prone to erosion.
 
• They play an important role in the carbon cycle by sequestering carbon dioxide through photosynthesis.
 
• Several species are utilized for ornamental purposes due to their aesthetic foliage.
 
 
 
• **Evolutionary Importance:**
 
 
• Pteridophytes bridge the evolutionary gap between non-vascular bryophytes and seed-bearing gymnosperms.
 
• They exhibit structural adaptations such as true roots, stems, and leaves, reflecting significant evolutionary progress.
 
• Unlike bryophytes, they reproduce via spores and do not depend on water for fertilization.
